value.name: API Layer
value.description: Spring MVC controllers expose Ladux admin and user REST endpoints for authentication, catalog, order, payment, inventory, and account workflows.

value.name: Service Layer
value.description: Business services and implementations coordinate Ladux domain rules for shopping, inventory, payments, coupons, notifications, reviews, and users.

value.name: Data Layer
value.description: JPA entities, repositories, enums, SQL migrations, seed data, and schema nodes define Ladux persistence over PostgreSQL.

value.name: DTO And Contract Layer
value.description: Request, response, and transfer objects define the payload contracts exchanged between Ladux controllers, services, and clients.

value.name: Configuration And Security
value.description: Spring Boot configuration, JWT and OAuth security components, exception handling, application entry point, and project build settings configure Ladux runtime behavior.

value.name: Utility Layer
value.description: Shared helper classes provide reusable SKU, slug, and security support used across Ladux application code.

value.name: Test Layer
value.description: JUnit and Spring integration tests verify Ladux controllers, repositories, services, persistence, storage, pricing, and business flows.

value.name: Infrastructure
value.description: Docker and compose assets describe how the Ladux backend and its dependent services are built and deployed.

value.name: Documentation
value.description: Markdown documentation captures Ladux project guidance, operational notes, and API or development references.
